title: Compost-Fueled Cars: Wouldn't That Be Great? - Onion Talks - Ep. 1
summary: An Onion Talks satire in which a young media professional pitches compost-powered cars, offering the idea itself and leaving all implementation to others.
why: HN uses it as shorthand for vague, detail-free visionary pitches and as a satirical jab at TED-style techno-utopian talks.

quote.text: neatly summarizes so much of the breathless excitement of vague, detail-free scientific and entrepreneurial claims
